title: .NET 6 console app published self-contained: the runtime ships inside the artefact as a NuGet package

source.exclude_note: bin/ and obj/ are build outputs; obj/project.assets.json is written by restore, so the source stage is the checkout without it

artefact.note: dotnet publish --self-contained: the app's DLLs, LegacyApp.deps.json, and the whole .NET 6 runtime

shipped.note: direct reference; Newtonsoft.Json.dll is in the output. An old version with a published advisory (CVE-2024-21907)
direct reference; log4net.dll is in the output. Old, with a published advisory (CVE-2018-1285)
direct reference; ships as ICSharpCode.SharpZipLib.dll, so the file name doesn't match the package name. Old, with published advisories

the .NET 6 runtime itself, copied into the output by --self-contained. It comes from NuGet as a runtime pack named for the build machine (linux-x64 or linux-arm64 in the tool image), and LegacyApp.deps.json lists it with type runtimepack. No file in the source tree names it; 6.0.36 is the last public .NET 6 release

not_shipped.note: a direct reference in the project file, but .NET 6 contains a newer copy, so publish leaves the package out. An old version with a published advisory (CVE-2021-26701), so a tool that reports it raises a finding for code that never ships
direct reference; supplied by the framework at runtime, absent from deps.json. Old, with a published advisory (CVE-2018-8292)
direct reference; supplied by the framework at runtime, absent from deps.json. Old, with a published advisory (CVE-2019-0820)
a Roslyn analyzer referenced with PrivateAssets=all: it runs inside the compiler and nothing of it reaches the output

not_shipped_prefixes.note: the System.* closure that log4net 2.0.8 and the old System.* references pull into the restore graph (67 packages): all supplied by the framework, none in deps.json
runtime.* platform packages from the same closure (39); none in deps.json
Microsoft.Win32.* packages from the same closure; none in deps.json
a restore-time metadata package; nothing ships
